description: Unit tests for authentication hashing utilities including v1/v2 hashing, verification, tenant orgSalt management, and migration logic.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves the pepper used in password hashing, imported from './authHash'.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes a password using legacy v1 method with SECRET_SALT.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes a password with tenant orgSalt and optional pepper using v2 method.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against stored hash, considering hash version and tenant salt.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures a tenant document has a generated orgSalt, creating and saving it if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Wrapper function defaults to v2 hashing with tenant orgSalt and pepper.

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies a user's password and migrates legacy v1 hashes to v2 if necessary.
